data.name: Keep Swimming
data.detailed_description:
Keep Swimming is a multiplayer underwater hide-and-seek game for two to eight players. One Diver hunts in smaller games, while a second joins larger lobbies. Everyone else disguises themselves as fish and hides among the local schools.

Diver Role

The Divers must find and catch every player fish before the hunt ends. Watch how each school moves, listen for a badly timed meal, and look for the fish that turns or bolts at the wrong moment. Scatter Pulse and Chum Bait force nearby schools to react, helping a sharp-eyed hunter spot anyone who fails to follow the crowd.

Choose each shot carefully. Catching a player fish keeps the hunt alive, but spearing an innocent fish costs Sanity.

Fish Role

Fish survive by looking like they belong. Join a school, match its speed, copy its movements, and eat before hunger gives away your hiding place. Feeding at the wrong moment could put every eye on you.

Fake a feed or flee with the school when a Diver tests your hiding place. If your cover is blown, a Panic Dash might save you. If the fish hold out long enough, Blood Tide begins. The Divers lose their weapons, the surviving fish fight back, and the hunters become the hunted.

Reef Basin

Reef Basin is an underwater hunting ground filled with coral, kelp, sand banks, bubbles, and roaming prey. Thirty decoy fish live across eleven different habitats, each with its own movement and habits. Some schools stay close together. Others drift, scatter, or break away to feed.

Learn the basin, choose the right school, and try not to look like a player pretending to be a fish.

Four Rounds

When the expedition ends, the player with the highest score wins. Whatever happens, keep swimming.

data.short_description: One or two Divers hunt up to six friends hiding among schools of fish in an underwater game of hide-and-seek. Copy the locals, stay fed and don’t give the hunters a clean shot. Just keep swimming...

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later 64-bit (latest update)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 or AMD Ryzen 5 1400
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 or AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
